resources.notes: CPI-005 adapts the single-player constants, weights, effect resolution and row draw order into pure versioned modules. The standalone stream is bounded, serializable and endless, with lossless absolute indices and mystery beyond350. AI, ranking and hidden350 finish are omitted. Independent fixtures retain immutable-source evidence; the original repository is unchanged.

CPI-005 extracts state transitions from choice, hint, mystery and periodic-effect handlers, with explicit standalone timing, fatal-progress and SP-cap rules. React board/menu extraction remains future work; the season/Redux/AI host and old result callbacks are not copied. Bound row/resolution buffers and exact absolute indices belong to the new core.
CPI-008 reuses the pinned glass bridge, perspective, lighting and tile-state CSS with a narrow-portrait/safe-area overlay. The old AI/season React runtime and its feed/standings are not mounted.

Original bitmap provenance/rights remain separately tracked; it is not silently copied. CPI-008 supplies a bundled CSS-rendered black-hole atmosphere and rings, available offline without a network request. Exact bitmap comparison/replacement remains an asset review.
Safe-step audio.
Death audio.
Potential personal-best/run-result cue after review; the standalone game has no fixed final-row victory.
Optional start/resume cue; no season turn loop.
New shell owns music playback and interruption behavior.
Four SFX only; old global sound service is broader than needed.

Reference lifecycle/consent patterns only; add a standalone provider and SSV ledger. Re-evaluate all-ages child/unknown privacy, applicable parental/consent flows, exact Families SDK versions and closeability; do not inherit an adult-only policy.

Rewarded-only config and new app/ad-unit IDs; no interstitial requirement. Apply the separately resolved privacyContext and permitted child/unknown settings before relevant data processing; optional age analytics never grants ad permission.
Fresh app identity; copy only needed safe-area/platform patterns.
Review safe-area/idle-timer patterns without story icon plugin.
Timeout/session patterns only; replace anonymous install-bound identity.

Independent literal source expectations and captured original route vectors verify constants, weights, effect priorities, expiry and consumed resources. Original ranking/350 finish are historical evidence; standalone changes are explicit. Separate stream/run tests cover bounded memory, save/resume and lossless progress.

CPI-005 references survived-wrong and historical fatal-progress behavior in pinned-source fixtures. No React async-flow suite is ported yet; rendering/unmount and gameplay integration remain subsequent tasks.
Keep only useful presentation invariants.
Replace host wiring with standalone lifecycle and backend tests.
Proprietary copyright 2026 Georgi Kolev; asset-specific checks still required.

The immutable original mulberry32 implementation is used only to capture independent source route vectors. New practice RNG and injected route/reward cursors belong to the standalone core; the whole store is not copied.
